plan.title: Create Single-Stage RFQ from Service PR

steps.note: Enable eRFX project creation for the test company.
Allow vendors to be added during creation so publishing is possible.
Provide the mandatory event title required for publishing.
Verify that the RFQ price sheet rendered the expected PR and pricing columns.
Verify that core PR-derived item fields are read-only on the create sheet.
Verify that the transferred PR quantity is shown.
Verify that the transferred PR unit is shown.
Add the two vendors named by the test case.
Confirm that publishing reached a real project page.
Open the event list to verify the published event's list status.
Check the event's post-publish status in the events list.
Return to the published event page for its PR-specific action state.
Verify that Recreate Order is present but greyed out for this PR-created event.
